demo.program:
# Brazil — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the capital of Brazil?", "Brasília"),
    ("What currency does Brazil use?", "Real"),
    ("What is capital?", "Brasília"),
    ("What is currency?", "Real (BRL)"),
    ("What is calling code?", "+55"),
    ("What is internet domain?", ".br"),
    ("What is driving side?", "right"),
    ("What is continent?", "South America"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
